posts.subject: Suggestion of Luckiris - 27 may 2017 ( TTT, Knife, Teamspeak )
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dream Community, I want to suggest some stuff for the servers.
I hope that there will be something useful for the community. Sorry if you had some of those maps before.
Have fun reading.


Part 1


TTT Server


1) Maps


  • ttt_caboose

    • Link : 
    • Size : Big
    • Weapons status : Placed on the map
    • My opinion : 2-3 little floors per train so there is some cover for close fights. You die if you fall off of the train. Can hold a lot of players.


  • ttt_subway

    • Link : 
    • Size : Medium
    • Weapons status : Not placed
    • My opinion : A lot of close-fights possible and a lot of possibility for the traitors. Tested by @Unicorn24


  • ttt_stormy_day_slayers

    • Link : 
    • Size : Small
    • Weapons status : Not placed
    • My opinion : Cool map but not for a lot of players in my opinion


  • ttt_border_b20_sgedit-1

    • Link : 
    • Size : Huge
    • Weapons status : Placed on the maps
    • My opinion : I found this map very interesting but I think this map is maybe too big for the server.






Link for all TTT maps :  (DROPBOX)
Link for all TTT maps :  (GOOGLE DRIVE)



2) Plugins :


  • [CS:GO/CS:S] Weapon Spawner

    • Title : [CS:GO/CS:S] Weapon Spawner
    • Link : 
    • Description : I found a plugin which can help for the maps who don't have weapons on it, the plugin just need a database to work (SQLite or MySQL) to store the configuration and that’s all. Then, you go in-game and placed the weapons with a menu


  • [CS:GO] Reject Client [V 1.0]

    • Title : [CS:GO] Reject Client [V 1.0]
    • Link : 
    • Description : Plugin who kick the players if the server is full (admin with the flag BAN excepted) but can be used on any server with any gamemode

So here is my opinion on both sets of maps.


TTT MAPS:


  • ttt_caboose: is NO for me because the looks too small and any kills by traitor would be seen immediately.



  • TTT_Subway: There is only one picture in link you sent so I am NEUTRAL about this map.



  • ttt_stormy_days_slayers: This map with the weather settings look very good so I will say YES for this one.
  • TTT_Borders_B20_SGedit-1: as @Luckiris said it might be too big plus I don't like that bright visual, but this might be just me so let's not count that as a factor. So I say NO to this too.



KNIFE MAPS:


  • 35hp_alex_the_allegator: That green color is not good and the map looks too much focused on 2 levels combat which wpuld give too big advantage to the Rubin rank players with no falls damage. NO
  • 35hp_oldschools_2017: Great map with option to 1v1? Totally YES.
  • 35hp_lego_2: In my opinion it is too simple and that middle would be hell of 2v1 cause those 4 access routes. NO.
  • ka_greybone: Though it is looking very nice it is not that good on the gameplay site it seems. A lot of objects in a way and access routes to some areas seems a bit limited. NO
  • ka_outside_aztec: Well this is a bit diffcult. In case that the water kills you I am against this map. But hoping that the water is only decoration I say YES. It is simple like that map before but here it is a good was to "team pushing" and when we will keep it civilized and don't 2v1 (and by me I mean players) it is a good idea.
  • ka_kei: well I like that futuristic design but it is not that graphically appealing to my eyes. Plus there is a lot of places they are accessable from few spot and can be easilly camped. Therefore I say NO to this one.

Well ther you have it. @Luckiris good maps but some of them are not for us in my opinion. Though I would like to point that I am 100 % against them, if they are added I wouldn't be mad but if you ask, here is my opinion. @wickedy .


P.S. When I was writing this I was a bit tired so my thoughts are correct but my grammar might be a bit bad 😄

Thanks @Thorin Pikachu for your opinion because that's what I wanted, you know, some advices and thoughts about those maps because sometimes I don't really know if the maps could be good or not so thank you @Thorin Pikachu and thank you @wickedy for taking care of that.

Whoops, @OxygeN 27th of May not March.
Nonetheless, sorry for the late reply, the thread kinda got lost in the english section.


I'll try to keep my reply short.


Suggestion regarding TS³:
We don't think a plugin like that would be useful. We don't want to "force" users on our teamspeak to farm new ranks. And we feel like it would add a level of unnecessary complexity.


Regarding the plugin suggestions:
Reject plugin will be installed on all servers
Weapon spawner will be installed on TTT to create the opportunity to add weapons to maps if necessary


Regarding your map selection:
I just had a quick look at the maps and am convinced we can add most of them to our servers with the exception of ttt_border / ttt_stormy for the reasons @wickedy already stated.


As always we appreciate your effort, we apologize for the long processing time.


Best regards


BlackFire
